messages:
ada: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp CI failing on main after a typegen regen.

ada: Error is from auth retry defaults flipping to exponential instead of constant backoff, which made our test timeout.

liam: repro steps?

ada: checkout main, run `yarn && yarn test sampleapp` then see failing test:
```
Error: expected auth retry delay 100ms, got 200ms
at auth.test.ts:42
```

sam: I saw a regen diff in CI: typegen changed default param in models/openapi.yaml -> retry.backoff.type: exponential

mira: Oof. That feels like a breaking change. Was the default documented anywhere? I thought we kept defaults stable to avoid semver bumps.

jules: Looks like a codegen change slipped through when we updated the retry lib. Typegen emitted new enum value as default.

ada: CI shows failing sampleapp snapshot and other downstream repos that pin to previous behavior.

liam: quick fix is to pin the typegen output to previous default in our sampleapp until we push a patch. I'll open a PR.

liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/712 — pins retry.default to "constant"

mira: For the upstream fix, we should either revert the typegen default or ship a patch release and add a changelog entry. Semver-wise, default change looks like a major if consumers rely on it.

jules: I propose we keep emitted default as-is but emit a note in the changelog and bump major in the next release. For now, revert the generator behavior in a patch to avoid breaking installs.

sam: Also recommend adding a regen-diff CI guard that fails when typegen output changes default values without an accompanying changelog entry.

ada: Agree. Also add a tiny integration test in sampleapp to assert retry delay remains <= 150ms by default.

deploy-bot: CI update: sampleapp/CI failed — 3 tests failed — see https://ci.redwood.example/12345 :warning:

mira: I'll draft the patch: fix typegen to preserve legacy default unless opt-in flag `--use-new-retry` is set. Will include changelog note and migration guide.

liam: Thanks — can you link the PR here when ready? I'll coordinate the sampleapp revert.

mira: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/999 — includes tests and changelog. Marked as patch.

ada: Perfect. Assigning follow-ups: mira -> typegen PR, liam -> sampleapp pin, sam -> regen-diff CI rule, jules -> verify semver guidance.

ada: Also add a short blurb to onboarding docs so new users aren't surprised by retry behaviour changes.

liam: done: docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/424

ada: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — will monitor CI after merges.
